message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user is building multi-dimensional componentisation into a conversation context viewer app. This session focused on:
   - Fixing the waffle chart to show a single blended chart with tuple-based legends (pairs/triads) instead of separate per-dimension charts
   - Fixing the "default" dimension disappearing when adding a new dimension
   - Making component filters work across all dimensions with AND logic
   - Showing multi-dimension component badges in conversation view
   - Grouping filter checkboxes by dimension
   - Fixing "Generate analysis" to auto-generate summary first when missing
   - Adding multi-dimension support to import/export
   - Fixing stale waffle chart when new dimension completes processing
   - Making workflow section show tuple legends
   - Writing regression tests for export/import

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - `DimensionData` interface: `{ name, prompt, components, componentMapping, componentTimeline, componentColors, customComponents?, customColoringPrompt? }`
   - Tuple-based component keys: e.g. `"workflow:project_context|error_types:ruff_check"` for multi-dimension waffle chart
   - AND filtering logic: a part is hidden if ANY of its components (across all dimensions) is unchecked
   - Color blending via `blendColors()` for multi-dimension waffle squares
   - `activeDimensionsKey` (serialized string) instead of Set reference for useMemo deps
   - Backward-compatible export format: `dimensions` field is optional on both parts and FileExport
   - Legacy field sync: `syncLegacyFieldsFromDimensions` falls back to first dimension if "default" renamed
   - `ensureDimensions` only migrates legacy fields when dimensions dict is completely empty

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`src/components/ComponentsView.tsx`** — Central component for waffle chart and workflow visualization
     - Replaced per-dimension waffle charts with single blended chart using tuple keys
     - Added `activeDimensionsKey` for stable useMemo deps
     - `tupleData` useMemo computes `Record<string, number>` where keys are `"dim1:comp1|dim2:comp2"`
     - `getTupleColorStyles` returns blended colors per tuple
     - `messageComponents` now produces tuple keys when multi-dim active
     - Added `WorkflowTupleLegend` component for tuple-based workflow legend
     - Removed `MultiDimensionLegend` component (replaced by tuple approach)
     ```typescript
     const activeDimensionsKey = [...activeDimensions].sort().join(",");
     
     const tupleData = useMemo(() => {
       if (!dimensions || activeDimensions.size <= 1) return null;
       const activeDimNames = [...activeDimensions].sort();
       const tupleTokens: Record<string, number> = {};
       // ... builds tuple keys from all active dimensions per part
       return { tupleTokens, total };
     }, [dimensions, activeDimensionsKey, conversation.messages, currentMessageIndex, filteredPartIds, messageTypeFilters]);
     ```

   - **`src/components/WaffleChart.tsx`** — Added `hideLegend?: boolean` prop (currently unused but available)

   - **`src/components/ConversationView.tsx`** — Conversation view with filters
     - Component filter dropdown groups checkboxes by dimension when `dimensions && Object.keys(dimensions).length > 1`
     - All 4 filter locations use AND logic: collect all components across all dimensions for a part, hide if any is unchecked
     - Added `dimensions` to `SourceWorkflowState` interface
     - Added `effectiveAutoComponentMapping` and `selectedAutoComponentMatchesPart` (user's manual edits for tuple selection support)
     ```typescript
     // AND logic: hide part if ANY component is unselected
     const partComponents: string[] = [];
     const legacyComp = componentMapping[part.id];
     if (legacyComp) partComponents.push(legacyComp);
     if (dimensions) {
       for (const dim of Object.values(dimensions)) {
         const dc = dim.componentMapping[part.id];
         if (dc && !partComponents.includes(dc)) partComponents.push(dc);
       }
     }
     if (partComponents.length === 0 || partComponents.some(c => !selectedComponents.has(c))) {
       return false;
     }
     ```

   - **`src/components/MessagePartView.tsx`** — Shows badges from ALL dimensions (not just active)
     - Changed condition from `activeDimensions.size > 1` to `dimNames.length > 1`
     ```typescript
     const dimNames = dimensions ? Object.keys(dimensions) : [];
     const dimensionBadges = dimensions && dimNames.length > 1
       ? dimNames.map((dimName) => { ... })
       : null;
     ```

   - **`src/App.tsx`** — Central state management (3100+ lines)
     - `syncLegacyFieldsFromDimensions`: Falls back to first dimension if "default" doesn't exist
     - `ensureDimensions`: Only migrates when `Object.keys(ctx.dimensions).length === 0`
     - `handleAddDimension`: Migrates legacy fields to "default" dimension before adding new one
     - `createAnalysisActivity`: Collects components from ALL dimensions, relaxed guard (no `componentTimeline` requirement), added diagnostic logging
     - Auto-generates summary before analysis when `aiSummary` is missing
     - `handleGenerateAnalysis` passes `onSummaryChunk` callback
     - `components` prop to ConversationView merges from all dimensions
     - `sourceWorkflowStates` includes `dimensions`
     - Preset export includes per-dimension prompts
     - Import restore rebuilds `DimensionData` from imported dimensions
     ```typescript
     // handleAddDimension fix
     let dims = { ...(conv.dimensions || {}) };
     if (Object.keys(dims).length === 0 && conv.components) {
       dims["default"] = {
         name: "default", prompt: conv.customPrompt,
         components: conv.components || [], componentMapping: conv.componentMapping || {},
         componentTimeline: conv.componentTimeline || [], componentColors: conv.componentColors || {},
       };
     }
     ```

   - **`src/lib/export-schema.ts`** — Zod schemas for export format
     - Added `dimensions` to `ExportPartSchema`: `z.record(z.string(), z.string()).optional()`
     - Added `ExportDimensionSchema`: `{ components, colors, prompt?, coloringPrompt? }`
     - Added `dimensions` to `FileExportSchema`: `z.record(z.string(), ExportDimensionSchema).optional()`

   - **`src/lib/export-builder.ts`** — Export building functions
     - `buildConversationWithComponents` embeds per-dimension component mappings on each part
     - `buildFileExport` includes per-dimension colors/prompt/components when multiple dimensions exist
     - Added `DimensionData` to WorkflowState interface

   - **`src/parsers/context-viewer-parser.ts`** — Import parser
     - `extractMetadata` now returns `dimensions` field from file export

   - **`src/parser.ts`** — Parser types
     - Added `dimensions` to `ConversationMetadata` interface

   - **`src/ai-summary.ts`** — Analysis generation
     - `generateContextAnalysis` accepts optional `dimensions` parameter
     - Generates per-dimension CSV data when multiple dimensions exist

   - **`vitest.config.ts`** — New file, vitest configuration with `@` path alias

   - **`src/lib/__tests__/export-import.test.ts`** — New test file (just written, not yet run)
     - Schema validation tests against real exports from `../long-prompts-analysis/context-viewer-exports/`
     - ContextViewerParser tests (canParse, parse, extractMetadata)
     - Single-dimension round-trip test
     - Multi-dimension round-trip test
     - Backward compatibility test (old export without dimensions)
     - Session export test

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **`filteredPartIds` used before declaration**: Moved `perDimensionTokens` useMemo after `filteredPartIds` declaration
   - **TS2322 in export-builder.ts**: `Record<string, unknown>` didn't match ExportPart type. Fixed by using `ExportPart` type explicitly
   - **TS2339 `dimensions` not on SourceWorkflowState**: Added `dimensions?: Record<string, DimensionData>` to the interface
   - **Generate analysis silently failing**: Guard required `componentTimeline?.length` which was empty. Relaxed guard, but real issue was missing `aiSummary`. Added auto-generate summary before analysis
   - **Default dimension disappearing**: `handleAddDimension` used `{ ...(conv.dimensions || {}) }` which created empty dict when dimensions hadn't been explicitly created yet. Fixed by migrating legacy fields to "default" first
   - **Component filter only worked for default dimension**: Changed all 4 filter locations to check all dimensions' componentMapping
   - **Waffle chart not updating when new dimension completes**: `useMemo` deps included Set reference which isn't reliably compared by React. Added `activeDimensionsKey` string serialization
   - **User feedback on filter logic**: User explicitly asked for AND logic — "if one component is unselected, it should not appear, even if the segment has other components which are not filtered"

5. Problem Solving:
   - Solved single blended waffle chart with tuple-based approach
   - Solved dimension rename bug by making legacy sync use first dimension as fallback
   - Solved analysis generation by auto-generating summary first
   - Solved stale waffle with string-serialized Set for memoization
   - Export/import backward compatibility via optional `dimensions` field
